acceptance.given: A historical wrapper replay claim whose recorded original-wrapper launch event is absent.

oracle.expected: The replay validator rejects the claim and records that the original wrapper launch was not observed.
forbidden: The claim is accepted from indirect, inferred, or non-launch evidence.
oracle.observable: The selected replay test's rejection result and diagnostic for the missing original-wrapper launch.

acceptance.then: The missing original-wrapper launch is a failing replay condition.
acceptance.when: The replay validator evaluates the historical wrapper replay claim.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the historical-wrapper replay case with its original-wrapper launch event removed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require historical replay validation to observe an actual original-wrapper launch before it can accept the replay claim.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback removes only the historical-wrapper launch observation requirement; historical records remain append-only and non-authorizing.

slice_hint.state_transition: A historical replay claim lacking an observed original-wrapper launch transitions from unverified to rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected test proves the claim fails without an observed original-wrapper launch and cannot succeed on indirect or inferred evidence.

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages participating in one evaluation and rollback workflow.

oracle.expected: Structural inspection verifies independently controlled mutable-state boundaries for each listed component and rejects cross-component mutable-state or evidence reuse that can create false success.
forbidden: A component mutates another listed component's execution or result through shared mutable state.
Shared evidence makes a false success possible.
oracle.observable: The selected test's explicit component-boundary assertions and contamination rejection.

acceptance.then: A shared mutable-state or false-success evidence boundary is rejected.
acceptance.when: The workflow's component state boundaries are constructed or inspected before evaluation and rollback execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Construct a workflow fixture that aliases mutable state or success evidence between two listed components and require the boundary assertion to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Represent and enforce separate mutable-state and evidence boundaries for Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback restores the prior toolchain boundary implementation without merging persisted component state or evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Components sharing one workflow move from potentially shared mutable state to independently controlled state boundaries.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected structural test rejects every attempted mutable-state or false-success-evidence alias among the listed component classes.

acceptance.given: A Consumer Manifest containing non-empty entries and their applicable route transitions.

oracle.expected: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry completes every applicable route transition, observes the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback, and the manifest is reconciled bidirectionally with the repository's real VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call surface.
forbidden: Any applicable transition is omitted or incomplete for a non-empty entry.
A manifest entry or real VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing consumer is absent from either side of the reconciliation.
Rollback fails to observe the Prior Behavior Baseline.
oracle.observable: The selected replay test's per-entry transition results, rollback-baseline assertions, and bidirectional Consumer Manifest reconciliation.

acceptance.then: The route and rollback evaluation fails if any applicable transition or either reconciliation direction is incomplete.
acceptance.when: Applicable route transitions execute for each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry and rollback completes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer Manifest replay fixture with one applicable transition omitted for a non-empty entry.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Evaluate every applicable transition per non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, require rollback observation of the Prior Behavior Baseline, and reconcile the complete manifest bidirectionally with VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing real callers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback returns route handling to the Prior Behavior Baseline without removing Consumer Manifest history.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each non-empty manifest entry moves from pending applicable transitions to complete transition coverage and post-rollback baseline observation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected test reports 100% completion for applicable transitions of every non-empty entry, baseline observation after rollback, and bidirectional reconciliation with all real VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers.

acceptance.given: A successful Replay Result whose Validator Capability verification has not yet been independently established.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independent verification of Validator Capability before it is accepted.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result is accepted without independent Validator Capability verification.
oracle.observable: The selected replay test's successful-result record containing the independent Validator Capability verification.

acceptance.then: The result is rejected when its independent Validator Capability verification is absent or invalid.
acceptance.when: A Replay Result succeeds and is evaluated for acceptance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute a successful replay-result fixture without its independent Validator Capability verification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful Replay Result to carry an independent Validator Capability verification before acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback removes only the new acceptance check; existing Replay Result records and their bindings remain unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result without independent Validator Capability verification transitions to rejected; one with valid independent verification is accepted.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected test accepts a successful Replay Result only when its independent Validator Capability verification is recorded and rejects the otherwise-successful result when it is absent.
